subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: After repairing persistence ordering, should OpenClaw keep `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` and the generic synchronous queue timeout hook as permanent contracts?
rationale: The bug needs bounded maintenance, but the dedicated public config key and generic queue callback are broader long-term API choices that correctness review alone cannot settle.

options.title: Reuse core timeout policy
options.body: Use an existing host-owned safety budget and narrow or remove the generic callback if the maintenance lifecycle can own timeout directly.

options.title: Keep proposed contracts
options.body: Retain the opt-in setting and callback after the ordering race is fixed and compatibility is explicitly accepted.

recommendation.title: Reuse core timeout policy
recommendation.body: Use an existing host-owned safety budget and narrow or remove the generic callback if the maintenance lifecycle can own timeout directly.

likelyOwner.reason: His major runtime refactor and recent merger history make him the strongest available routing candidate for the permanent product and API contract.
